jobDescription: We are seeking a highly motivated, analytically inclined, and results-oriented GTM Associate (Entry-Level) to contribute to our comprehensive Go-to-Market strategies for B2B Software as a Service (SaaS) products. This position is designed for recent university graduates or those in the final year of study who are eager to acquire practical experience in product launch, market positioning, and scaling within a dynamic startup environment. The incumbent will collaborate cross-functionally with Product Development, Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success teams. Key objectives include supporting product launches, gathering crucial customer insights, and enhancing the overall process of bringing products to market. This role offers substantial, hands-on exposure to startup operations, SaaS growth methodologies, and real-world business strategy formulation. This is a high-impact, developmental role, with a clear trajectory toward assuming ownership of key GTM initiatives over time.

tasks: Provide direct support in the execution of formalized go-to-market plans for new product features and major launches.
Conduct research and data synthesis to precisely identify target customer segments and detailed buyer personas.
Assist in the development of concise, impactful messaging, comprehensive product explanations, and formalized value propositions.
Facilitate cross-functional coordination with Product, Marketing, and Sales teams to meticulously track GTM tasks and adhere to established timelines.
Execute foundational market and competitive research, providing a data-driven overview of the landscape.
Systematically collect and document customer feedback derived from sales calls, product demonstrations, support tickets, and formal surveys.
Contribute to the documentation of defined customer pain points and analysis of buying behavior patterns.
Monitor and report on key foundational metrics (product adoption, engagement rates, feedback trends) and prepare concise performance summaries.
Aid in the formal creation of sales enablement collateral, including pitch decks, comprehensive FAQs, product one-pagers, and standardized demo scripts.
Organize and disseminate product information and feature updates to effectively support the Sales organization.
Gather structured feedback from Sales and Customer Success channels and synthesize these insights for the Product and Marketing teams.
Coordinate GTM activities across relevant departments, ensuring timely completion of all follow-up actions.
Participate actively in GTM synchronization meetings, accurately documenting proceedings and tracking actionable items.
Work closely with founders or senior management to execute weekly strategic GTM tasks.
Cultivate a deep understanding of GTM strategy implementation within the context of real-world SaaS businesses.
Under the mentorship of senior staff, analyze user behavior and assess campaign performance data.
Propose and document continuous incremental improvements to product messaging, onboarding processes, and market positioning.

minimumQualifications.education: Completion of a Bachelor's degree or current enrollment in the final year of a program in Marketing, Business Administration, Engineering, or a closely related discipline.
minimumQualifications.mindset: Demonstrably curious, proactive, and committed to rapid learning within an agile startup environment.
minimumQualifications.communication: Excellent command of written and verbal communication.
minimumQualifications.technicalProficiency: Competence in utilizing standard business tools, specifically Google Sheets/Excel, presentation software, and research methodologies.
minimumQualifications.interest: A profound interest in the startup ecosystem, SaaS product lifecycle, growth hacking, and advanced business strategy.
minimumQualifications.execution: Proven ability to manage and complete assigned tasks and effectively collaborate across multiple teams.

preferredQualifications.understanding: Foundational understanding of the SaaS business model, startup operations, or B2B products.
preferredQualifications.familiarity: Familiarity with enterprise software tools such as Notion, Slack, HubSpot, or Salesforce.
preferredQualifications.experience: Prior internship or project experience in a functional area such as marketing, sales, product management, or growth.
preferredQualifications.contentCreation: Experience with professional content creation, social media strategy, or community management.

benefitsAndPerks: Direct, substantive exposure to the realities of a scaling startup environment.
Opportunity to work directly with company founders and the product development leadership.
Comprehensive learning opportunity covering GTM strategy, SaaS growth principles, and fundamental business acumen.
Accelerated professional development trajectory coupled with significant ownership of work over time.
